fullDesc: In 1984 Alexey Pajitnov, working at the Soviet Academy of Sciences in Moscow, created Tetris. After a tangled licensing fight, it shipped with the Game Boy in 1989 and sold hundreds of millions of copies across versions.
realFacts: Nintendo bundled Tetris with the Game Boy in 1989
Henk Rogers helped secure the rights from the Soviet Union
Pajitnov moved to the United States in 1996
More than 500 million copies have been sold across versions
